FN-8X3CFFH-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 162
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Will Barfoot
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/05/2024
Senate Bill 162 as introduced would add two at-large members, to the Study Commission on
Interagency Cooperation and Collaboration on the Rehabilitation and Reintegration of Formerly
Incarcerated Individuals, which could increase the obligations of the Legislature, paid from the
State General Fund, to reimburse the two additional members of the Commission for necessary
expenses incurred in attending meetings of the Commission, by an estimated maximum of $675
per meeting. However, pursuant to existing law, meeting expenses of the Commission are
capped at $5,000.

FN-8X3CFFH-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 162
Committee: ENACTED Sponsor: Senator Will Barfoot
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 06/12/2024
Senate Bill 162 (Act 2024-404) as enacted adds four additional members to the Study
Commission on Interagency Cooperation and Collaboration on the Rehabilitation and
Reintegration of Formerly Incarcerated Individuals, which will increase the obligations of the
Legislature, paid from the State General Fund, to reimburse the four additional members of the
Commission for necessary expenses incurred in attending meetings of the Commission, by an
estimated maximum of $1,350 per meeting. However, pursuant to existing law, meeting
expenses of the Commission are capped at $5,000.
